findings.resolution: Directory members could escape using lexical .. parents. All member names now reject traversal/absolute/noncanonical paths and resolved containment rejects symlink ancestors.
Offline npm alone allowed lifecycle scripts. Install now uses --offline --ignore-scripts with locked source and no online fallback.
Embedded valid receipts and unrelated successful transactions were insufficient. All five now bind DB run/billing, exact canonical RunSettled event, original journal hash/nonce and signer/to.
Post-start anchor alone did not prove zero transactions. Before/after canonical head/stateRoot plus account/nonce/balance/code/run/Leash digest must match for both starts.
Whole-row hashes could reject legitimate additive schema. All original columns/types/values are pinned, with only explicit jobs.agent_address and transaction_journal.nonce additions allowed.
Killing systemd-run could leave the real Node unit. Finally now stops or kills only the exact owned unit and verifies inactive/failed with MainPID0.
A lost docker-run acknowledgement could leave cid unset. Creation attempt is retained, then only the exact expected name and owner label can resolve the full cleanup ID.
One cleanup error previously skipped other owned resources. Bounded independent outcomes now cover Anvil, daemon, namespace and PG; any ambiguity blocks acceptance.
Type=simple start precedes HTTP readiness. Live/ready are now polled within a finite deadline.
Old executable/unit identity and full owned drop-in bytes are now pinned for cutover and rollback. Only exact controller drop-in is disabled with same-directory rename; no data restore.
Controller drop-in directory/target symlinks are explicitly refused.

Both actual controller processes inherit a dedicated Docker socket with verified daemon root and private socket; global container/image identities must remain equal. Only exact labelled clone PG is removed.
